Entertainment.title: 8 Drops You Don't Want to Miss This Week
Entertainment.text: With another week upon us, we have yet another installment of our product drops series.This week’s lineup of drops kicks off with Supreme officially launching its FW26 season with a massive collection featuring a Jeff Hamilton Box Logo leather jacket and a chromed-out motor scooter. Palace Skateboards follows with its Fall 2026 Drop 3, blending an archive baseball collaboration alongside Ebbets Field Flannels with biker-inspired moto gear. Drake's OVO reconnects with the UFC for a fighter-inspired apparel capsule fronted by Canadian welterweight Mike Malott, while Shinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD doubles down on motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics for its moody FW26 delivery. Technical outerwear takes center stage as Descente unveils its thermal-bonded "Mizusawa Down" FW26 range built at its newly rebuilt factory, while PLEASURES explores subcultural nostalgia and transitional layering in its "Somewhere In Between" collection. C2H4® translates 1950s mid-century interior design into contemporary urban menswear, and closing out the week, Bear Walker teams up with ONE PIECE for custom-carved, holographic Devil Fruit blindbox skate decks.Check out this week’s 8 drops you don’t want to miss below.Supreme FW26 Collection Drop 1Supreme officially kicks off its Fall/Winter 2026 season with the reveal of its complete apparel and accessories lineup. The expansive collection balances premium fabrications and fine art co-signs with heavy-duty outerwear, headlined by a standout Jeff Hamilton leather jacket adorned with an all-over patchwork appliqué of historical Box Logos. Alongside reimagined streetwear staples and artistic collaborations—including works by Rita Ackermann and Masato Kawajo—the brand pushes its accessory game to new heights with offerings like a chromed-out motor scooter and a Kodak Super 8 camera. Supreme’s FW26 collection will begin its initial rollout on August 20 globally through the brand's physical flagships and official webstore, followed by a release in Asia.Palace Skateboards Fall 2026 Drop 3Palace Skateboards continues its Fall 2026 rollout with its third delivery, anchored by a nostalgic collaboration with heritage sportswear manufacturer Ebbets Field Flannels. The capsule honors the archive graphics of historic baseball franchises like the Negro League's New York Cubans and Japan's Sankei Atoms across jersey-lined coach jackets, mesh V-necks, and wool ballcaps. Meanwhile, the mainline drop leans heavily into biker-inspired racing aesthetics and religious iconography, highlighted by the padded "Highway to Heaven" moto jacket and the neon wire-embroidered "Pray For Us" hoodie. Palace’s Fall 2026 Drop 3 is set to release on August 21 online and instores across the UK, EU, US and Canada, followed by an August 22 launch in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, and China.OVO x UFC CollaborationDrake's October's Very Own (OVO) and the UFC have reconnected for their second collaborative apparel collection, enlisting Canadian UFC welterweight Mike Malott to front the official campaign. The lifestyle capsule is designed to seamlessly bridge the intense world of mixed martial arts with premium contemporary fashion. The offering features an array of co-branded garments, including hoodies, athletic jerseys, graphic T-shirts, and long-sleeve shirts that combine fighter-inspired artwork with OVO's signature owl iconography. The highly anticipated OVO x UFC 2026 capsule is scheduled to release on August 21 through OVO’s physical flagships and official online store.NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 CollectionShinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD is gearing up for the colder months with its comprehensive Fall/Winter 2026 collection, doubling down on the brand’s signature fusion of motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics. Grounded in a moody palette of charcoal, faded indigo, and rich earth tones, the seasonal wardrobe is led by a heavy-duty outerwear selection that includes leather jackets, wool coats, and elaborately embroidered bombers. Staying true to its "Craft With Pride" ethos, the brand rounds out the collection with distressed knit sweaters, versatile button-ups, and adaptable bottom wear. The NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 collection officially launches on August 22 via the brand’s online store and select global retailers.Descente “Mizusawa Down” FW26 Collection Japanese technical label Descente has unveiled its premium “Mizusawa Down” Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear range, crafted at its newly rebuilt Mizusawa factory. The collection introduces a refined evolution of its signature non-quilted, thermal-bonded down jackets, engineered to merge minimalist urban styling with extreme weather performance. Flagship models like the "MOUNTAINEER," "ANCHOR," and "SHUTTLE-L" return with modernized shell fabrics and reworked functional details, joined by the debut of the limited, cold-weather "EXPEDITION" variant. An advance pre-order phase for the Descente "Mizusawa Down" FW26 collection begins on August 21 through the brand's official webstore, with subsequent global rollouts scheduled for September 18 and October 23.PLEASURES FALL 2026 CollectionLos Angeles-based streetwear imprint PLEASURES explores the tension between the familiar and the unknown in its Fall 2026 collection, aptly titled "Somewhere In Between." The seasonal delivery blends subcultural nostalgia with contemporary, relaxed fits, focusing heavily on versatile layering for the transitional weather. The comprehensive wardrobe highlights textured outerwear, tactile knitwear, relaxed denim, and the brand's signature bold graphic apparel. The PLEASURES "Somewhere In Between" Fall 2026 collection is available to shop now directly through the brand'sofficial website and select global stockists.C2H4® 012 Collection Fall DeliveryLos Angeles and Shanghai-based menswear label C2H4® expands its continuous, year-round 012 Collection with a new fall delivery that translates mid-century interior design into contemporary fashion. Drawing aesthetic cues from 1950s and 1960s architecture, the collection balances retro nostalgia with modern urban utility across refined, durable silhouettes designed to age naturally with the wearer. Standout garments include the Mechanic Washed Engineer Jacket, Moccasin Memory Textured Henley, and the Lake Tahoe Cabin Gentle Padded Vest. With prices ranging from $90 to $1,450 USD, the C2H4® 012 Collection fall delivery is available to purchase now via the brand's global webstore.Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate DeckSkateboarding artist Bear Walker has teamed up with the legendary anime franchise ONE PIECE for an exclusive Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate Deck collection. Merging high-end craftsmanship with pop culture, the custom-carved wooden decks feature holographic finishes and highlight key characters like Luffy, Chopper, and Blackbeard alongside their respective Devil Fruits. The mystery blind box packaging adds a thrilling element of surprise for collectors, with ultra-rare 1-of-1 chase boards hidden throughout the release. Priced at $110 USD each, the Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit collection officially drops on August 21 via Bear Walker's webstore and Pensacola flagship location.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Longevity & Anti-Aging.title: Greater Vascular Health in Mid-Life Reduces Later Risk of Dementia
Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: The state of the cardiovascular system has a strong impact on the aging of the brain. The brain requires an sizable supply of energy, delivered via the bloodflow, and suffers when that supply is reduced. With age, the vascular system loses smaller vessels, while larger vessels become damaged. Loss of physical fitness also reduces blood supply. Additionally, damaged blood vessels allow leakage of unwanted cells and molecules into the brain to produce inflammation, while blood vessel walls can be a source of inflammatory signaling themselves. Increased blood pressure can be avoided or controlled, but where hypertension is present, it is harmful to vessels in the brain, causing a toll of small ruptures that damage brain tissue over time.
